CORSAIR.gloss: a pirate along the Barbary Coast
CORSAIR.definition: A pirate along the Barbary Coast.

SCAR.gloss: a mark left by the healing of injured tissue
SCAR.definition: A mark left (usually on the skin) by the healing of injured tissue.

ROAR.definition: Make a loud noise, as of wind, water, or vehicles.

AIRS.gloss: affected manners intended to impress others
AIRS.definition: Affected manners intended to impress others.
AIRS.example: Don't put on airs with me.

SARI.gloss: a dress worn primarily by Hindu women
SARI.definition: A dress worn primarily by Hindu women; consists of several yards of light material that is draped around the body.

ORCA.gloss: predatory black-and-white toothed whale with large dorsal fin
ORCA.definition: Predatory black-and-white toothed whale with large dorsal fin; common in cold seas.

CAR.gloss: a motor vehicle with four wheels
CAR.definition: A motor vehicle with four wheels; usually propelled by an internal combustion engine.
CAR.example: He needs a car to get to work.

AIR.gloss: a mixture of gases required for breathing
AIR.definition: A mixture of gases (especially oxygen) required for breathing; the stuff that the wind consists of.

SIR.gloss: term of address for a man
SIR.definition: Term of address for a man.

ARC.gloss: electrical conduction through a gas in an applied electric field
ARC.definition: Electrical conduction through a gas in an applied electric field.

COS.gloss: ratio of the adjacent side to the hypotenuse of a right-angled triangle
COS.definition: Ratio of the adjacent side to the hypotenuse of a right-angled triangle.

IRA.gloss: belligerence aroused by a real or supposed wrong
IRA.definition: Belligerence aroused by a real or supposed wrong (personified as one of the deadly sins).
